sections.content:
Game over after RIGHT×2 from start again! This is very strange. Previously, RIGHT×2 from start also caused game over. But UP×4, RIGHT×3 succeeded.
Let me check: maybe the issue is that RIGHT from the start position (rows 39-40, cols 18-20) hits the w row at 38 or 42.
Looking at the w rows: 26, 30, 34, 38, 42. The player is at rows 39-40, which is between w rows 38 and 42. When the player moves RIGHT, maybe it also moves UP or DOWN, and hits the w row.
But UP×4, RIGHT×3 succeeded. After UP×4, the player is at rows 24-25, which is above w row 26. When the player moves RIGHT from there, it doesn't hit any w rows.
So the issue is that RIGHT from the start position (between w rows 38 and 42) hits a w row, but RIGHT from the top corridor (above w row 26) doesn't.
Let me try UP first, then RIGHT. UP×4 got the player to rows 24-25, and RIGHT×3 succeeded. So the plan is:
1. UP×4 to reach rows 24-25
2. RIGHT×3 to reach cols 27-32
3. Then... RIGHT caused game over from rows 24-25, cols 30-31.
Wait, but previously UP×4, RIGHT×3 succeeded, and then RIGHT caused game over. So the player can move RIGHT×3 from rows 24-25, but not RIGHT×4.
This suggests that there's an obstacle at cols 34-36 in the top corridor. The P dots are at cols ~30, 33, 36, 39. So the player might be hitting the P dot at col 33 or 36.
Let me try: UP×4, RIGHT×2 (to cols 24-26), then UP (but the player is already at the top), then... hmm.
Actually, maybe the player needs to move RIGHT in a lower corridor, not the top corridor. Let me try:
1. UP×3 to reach rows 27-29 (between w rows 26 and 30)
2. RIGHT×3 to reach cols 27-32
3. UP×1 to reach rows 24-26
4. RIGHT×3 to reach cols 36-44
5. ... but this might hit the orange obstacle at rows 27-29, cols 26-27.
Wait, the orange obstacle is at rows 27-29, cols 26-27. If the player is at rows 27-29, cols 18-20, and moves RIGHT×3, it would reach cols 27-32, which overlaps with the orange obstacle at cols 26-27. So the player would hit the orange obstacle.
Let me try: UP×2 to reach rows 31-33 (between w rows 30 and 34), then RIGHT×3 to reach cols 27-32, then UP×2 to reach rows 24-26, then RIGHT×3 to reach cols 36-44.
But the orange obstacle at rows 35-37, cols 38-40 is in the way. If the player is at rows 31-33, cols 27-32, and moves RIGHT×3, it would reach cols 36-44, which is above the orange obstacle at rows 35-37. So the player should be fine.
Let me try: UP×2, RIGHT×3, UP×2, RIGHT×3.
